title: The Modpack Modpack
description: Some mods that might be helpful to those wanting to make a more complex modpack!
body:
Some mods that might be helpful to those wanting to make a more complex modpack! This small modpack intends to provide a starting point for anyone wanting to make a modpack that goes beyond bundling a few mods together, instead making things more customized!

This modpack is primarily intended for 1.21.1, but feel free to look at the individual mods used to see if they're available on a more suitible version for your modpack! In truth, I made this modpack as a way to help myself (collecting up mods I think could be useful as I put together my first larger modpack), but if having these together in one place is helpful to anyone else, I'm happy ^^
